title.narrative: Realization of Eliminating TB in Indonesia - Indonesia (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Indonesia, Tuberculosis, Konsorsium Komunitas PENABULU-STPI (PR Konsorsium Komunitas)This program has the following goals: TB: To reduce TB incidence rate per 100,000 population from 354 in 2021 to 300 in 2026. TB: To reduce TB mortality rate per 100,000 population from 52 in 2021 to 26 in 2026. The objectives of this program are: To increase TB treatment coverage of new and relapse TB cases from 70% in 2022 to 90% for 2026 onwards. To improve TB quality of service by increasing treatment success rate of all forms TB cases to 90% from 2024 and beyond. To increase RR-TB and/or MDR-TB Treatment coverage from 42% in 2022 to 75% by 2026. To improve TB quality of service by increasing treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases to 80% % by 2026. To remove TB stigma in community settings
